# Set Slow Motion

Source: [4435](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4435); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Set Slow Motion](../../api/actions/set-slow-motion.md).

<a id="wiki-4435-n1"></a>

- Slow Motion changes simulation rate for players, projectiles, effects and game-mode logic; only rates up to 100% are allowed.
